title: Co-Signing a Loan Is a $21K Debt Waiting to Detonate
hook: You co-signed to help someone out — and the moment they missed one payment, you legally owe the entire $21,000 and your credit score just dropped 80 points.
angle: Most people think co-signing is a 'backup' role — they don't realize they're 100% equally liable from day one, and nearly 1 in 3 co-signers ends up making payments themselves.
audience: Anyone who has been asked to co-sign or is considering it for a friend, family member, or partner
key_numbers: 28% of co-signers are eventually forced to pay the full loan
Credit score drop from one late payment: 40-80 points
38% of co-signers say it permanently damaged the relationship
